title: Simple Past: Regular and Irregular Verbs / Pastin da yaushe: aiki da ba daidai ba
bridge: A cikin Turanci, pastin da yaushe ya kasance da wasu kalmomi masu fasaha (talked, played, lived). A cikin Turanci, kalmomin da suka dace da fasaha na iya samun -ed (talk → talked), amma wasu kalmomi masu yawa na iya canzawa da yawa (go → went). Kuma, a cikin Turanci, wannan fasaha ta kasance daidai ga dukan mutane (I went, you went, he went), while a cikin Turanci, watau a Turanci, wannan fasaha ta kasance daidai ga dukan mutane (I went, you went, he went), while a cikin Turanci, watau a Turanci, wannan fasaha ta kasance daidai ga dukan mutane (I went, you went, he went).
rule: Pastin da yaushe a Turanci yana amfani da aiki da suka gama a lokacin da ya gabata. Don kalmomin da suka dace da fasaha, ake samun -ed (work → worked, play → played). Idan kalmomin suka gabata da 'e', kawai ake samun -d (live → lived); idan kalmomin suka gabata da alamar 'y', alama 'y' ta canza zuwa 'i' da ake samun -ed (study → studied). Kalmomin masu yaushe na iya da fasaha masu fasaha (see → saw, eat → ate) da kowa ya iya yin komai. A cikin jayayya da tambayoyi, ake amfani da 'did' + fasaha na asali na kalmomin (I didn't go, Did you see?). Fasaha na tabbata ba ta sami 'did'. Pastin da yaushe yana amfani da kalmomin da suka dace da 'yesterday', 'last week', 'in 2010'.

concept_examples.text: I walked to the park yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Na tafi wajen filin wasanni jiya.

concept_examples.text: She ate an apple for breakfast.
concept_examples.translation: Ta ci alma a cikin abincin asuba.

concept_examples.text: We didn't watch TV last night.
concept_examples.translation: Ba mu gan wasanni da dare ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈdɪdnt wɑːtʃ tiː ˈviː læst naɪt/

common_error.correct_alt: She didn't go to school yesterday.
common_error.explanation: Wannan kuskure yana faruwa saboda a cikin Turanci, kalmomin suka dace da fasaha (na yaushe ba ne), amma a cikin Turanci, a kan sami 'did' (masu fasaha na yaushe), kalmomin suka dace da fasaha na asali: 'go'. Yi komai: 'did' ya nuna yaushe, saboda haka ba zai dace da fasaha ba.

levels.label: Regular Verbs
levels.translation: Kalmomin da suka dace da fasaha

examples.original: I played football last Sunday.
examples.translation: Na wasa kwallon wasanni da rai biyu.
examples.note: Ake samun -ed a kan kalmomin 'play' don samun 'played'.

examples.original: She studied for the exam.
examples.note: Idan kalmomin suka gabata da alamar 'y', alama 'y' ta canza zuwa 'i' da ake samun -ed: study → studied.

examples.original: We lived in Madrid for two years.
examples.phonetic: /wiː lɪvd ɪn məˈdrɪd fər tuː jɪrz/
examples.translation: Mun tsaya a Madrid na shekaru biyu.
examples.note: Kalmomin 'live' ya gabata da 'e', saboda haka kawai ake samun -d: lived.

examples.original: I went to the cinema with my friends.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ went tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə wɪð maɪ frendz/
examples.translation: Na tafi cinema tare da abokai.
examples.note: 'Go' na iya fasaha: 'went' a yaushe. Yi komai da fasaha masu fasaha da suka dace da go-went, see-saw, eat-ate.

examples.original: She saw a beautiful bird in the tree.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː sɔː ə ˈbjuːtɪfl bɜːrd ɪn ðə triː/
examples.translation: Ta gan wata tsuntsu mai kyau a cikin itace.
examples.note: 'See' ya canza zuwa 'saw'. Ba 'seed' ba.

examples.original: He ate all the cookies.
examples.note: 'Eat' ya canza zuwa 'ate'. An yi faɗa /eɪt/, ba /iːt/ ba.

examples.original: I didn't like the movie.
examples.translation: Ba na son fim da yaushe ba.
examples.note: A cikin jayayya, ake amfani da 'didn't' + kalmomin a fasaha na asali. Kalmomin 'like' ba zai canza ba.

examples.original: Did you finish your homework?
examples.note: A cikin tambayoyi, ake amfani da 'Did' + mutum + kalmomin a fasaha na asali. Ba a sami 'did' a cikin tabbatun ba.

examples.original: They didn't come to the party.
examples.translation: Sun ba komai zuwa wajen wasanni ba.
examples.note: Yi komai: 'come' na iya fasaha, amma a cikin jayayya an sami fasaha na asali 'come', ba 'came' ba.

title: Present Progressive / Tsarin ci gaba da aiki
bridge: A cikin turanci, tsarin ci gaba da aiki (am/is/are + verb + -ing) yana amfani da shi domin ayyuka da ke faruwa yanzu ko a cikin lokaci mai yawa. A cikin Hausa, muna yin amfani da tsarin yanzu da yaushe domin dukkan ayyuka (''na yi tattauna'' ko ''na yi''). Daga sabon da yake, masu magana Hausa kamar yadda suka yi, suna yi wasu kuskure ko suka yi wasa da 'to be' ko suka yi wasa da tsarin yanzu da ci gaba da yaushe. Tsarin turanci ya bambanta da Hausa saboda yana nuna faruwa mai ci gaba (present continuous) da faruwa da yaushe (present simple).
rule: Tsarin ci gaba da aiki yana da wata hanya: amfani da 'to be' da aka yi tasiri (am, is, are) + verb da aka adda -ing. Akan yi amfani da shi domin: 1) ayyuka da ke faruwa yanzu (''I am reading now''), 2) ayyuka masu yin aiki a cikin lokaci mai yawa (''She is working in Madrid these days''), da 3) shirye-ya-yake masu zuwa (''We are meeting at 5''). Ba zan yi amfani da shi tare da verbs of state (like, want, know, prefer) ba ko idan ba a matsayin sabon da yake. Tsarin negative yana da 'not' bayan da aka yi tasiri (''I am not sleeping''), da tsarin tambaya yana da canjewa da tasiri (''Are you listening?''). A cikin Hausa, tsarin ci gaba (ke + infinitive) ya daidai, amma turanci yana yin amfani da shi da yawa, saboda yake, saboda yake, saboda yake, saboda yake, saboda yake.

common_error.explanation: Wannan kuskure yana faruwa saboda a cikin Hausa ba zan adda wata terminación mai alama ga verb ba yayin da ke ci gaba (''na yi''). A turanci, bayan 'to be' da aka yi tasiri, dole ne a adda verb + -ing. Don haka, kuna buƙatar yarda da wannan tsarin: subject + am/is/are + verb-ing. Kadan kuna buƙatar adda -ing.

levels.label: Forming the Present Continuous
levels.translation: Yin tsarin ci gaba da aiki

examples.original: I am eating.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'am' da 'I'.

examples.original: He is running.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'is' da 'he, she, it'.

examples.original: They are playing football.
examples.translation: Suna ke wasanni da kwallon kafa.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'are' da 'you, we, they'.

examples.original: We are watching TV.
examples.note: Kadai canja 'y' zuwa 'i' da a dadda -ing (watch > watching).

examples.original: I am not sleeping.
examples.note: Negative yana da 'am not', 'is not', 'are not'.

examples.original: She is not crying.
examples.note: Tsarin mai hadawa ne: isn't.

examples.original: Are you studying?
examples.note: Canja subject da tasiri don tambaya.

examples.original: What is he doing?
examples.note: Tambayoyi masu 'wh-' suna da tasiri bayan kalmar tambaya.

examples.original: He is working in London these days.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ɪz ˈwɜːkɪŋ ɪn ˈlʌndən ðiːz deɪz/
examples.translation: Ya ke aiki a London wadanne lokuta.
examples.note: Yin amfani da shi domin ayyuka masu yin aiki a cikin lokaci mai yawa, ba masu yaushe ba.

examples.original: We are going to the cinema tomorrow.
examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə təˈmɒrəʊ/
examples.note: Yin amfani da shi domin shirye-ya-yake masu zuwa.

examples.original: I like this song.
examples.note: Kadai ka yi 'I am liking' saboda 'like' tsari ne mai halaye.

examples.original: She doesn't want to go.
examples.note: Yi amfani da tsarin yanzu da yaushe tare da verbs of state kamar 'want', 'know', 'prefer'.

title: Future with going to / Farkwace da 'going to'
bridge: A cikin Espanyol, don nuna abubuwan da za a yi a gaba, muna amfani da yawun da ke da yankin (na'ura) ko 'ir a + infinitive' ('yar gobe zan je cinema'). A turanci, 'be going to + verb' ya daidai da 'ir a + infinitive' na Espanyol, amma akwai farashin da ya bambanta: a turanci, dole ne ka sami 'to be' mai yankin (am/is/are) kafin 'going to', wanda ba a da wannan a Espanyol. Kuma, 'going to' yana amfani da plans da iyaka, amma ba da fatan za a yi ta hanyar bayyana bayan hanyar da aka gani (don haka 'will' ya kamata a wuce wannan).
rule: Don samar da farkwace da 'going to', dole ne ka yi: subject + 'to be' (am/is/are) + 'going to' + verb a yankin. A cikin positive: 'I am going to travel' (za zan tafi). A cikin negative: 'I am not going to travel' (ba zan tafi ba). A cikin question: 'Are you going to travel?' (za ka tafi?). Ana yin shi da tsari mai yankin: 'I'm going to', 'You're going to', etc. Ana amfani da shi don: 1) Plans da iyaka masu nuni (I'm going to study medicine), 2) Fatansa masu nuni da aka gani (Look at those clouds! It's going to rain). Ba a amfani da shi don fatansa masu rashin nuni (don haka 'will' ya kamata: 'I'll help you'). Yi tunani cewa 'going to' ba ya canza, kawai 'to be' ya canza.

concept_examples.text: I am going to visit my grandmother tomorrow.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈvɪzɪt maɪ ˈɡrændˌmʌðər təˈmɑːroʊ/

concept_examples.text: She is going to buy a new car.
concept_examples.translation: Ta za ta sayo motar sabuwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə baɪ ə nuː kɑːr/

concept_examples.text: We are not going to watch TV tonight.
concept_examples.translation: Ba zan duba TV wannan yamma ba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ɑːr nɒt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə wɒtʃ ˌtiːˈviː təˈnaɪt/

concept_examples.text: Are you going to come to the party?
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɑːr juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə kʌm tə ðə ˈpɑːrti/

common_error.wrong: I going to travel next week.
common_error.correct: I am going to travel next week.
common_error.correct_alt: I'm going to travel next week.
common_error.explanation: A cikin Espanyol, 'ir a' ba ya bukata wa wasu verbs masu yankin, amma a turanci 'going to' ya bukata wa 'to be' (am/is/are) a gabansa. Yarda cewa ba ka sami 'am' ya zama kuskure mai yawa ga wadanda suka yi magana da Espanyol. Yi tunani: ba ko da 'am/is/are', kalmar ba da wata grammatikal ce.

examples.original: I am going to study English tonight.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈstʌdi ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ təˈnaɪt/
examples.note: Yarda da 'am' da 'I'. Yi tunani da tsari mai yankin: 'I'm going to'.

examples.original: They are going to have dinner at a restaurant.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑːr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə hæv ˈdɪnər æt ə ˈrestrɑːnt/
examples.translation: Suna za su tafi watsin abinci a restaurant.
examples.note: Da 'they' muna da 'are'. 'Have dinner' ya nufi 'tafi watsin abinci'.

examples.original: He is going to call his boss.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə kɔːl hɪz bɒs/
examples.translation: Ya za ya kira masu jiya.
examples.note: Da 'he/she/it' muna da 'is'.

examples.original: I am not going to eat fast food.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ æm nɒt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə iːt fæst fuːd/
examples.translation: Ba zan ci abinci mai rashin lafiya ba.
examples.note: A negative, add 'not' bayan 'to be'.

examples.original: Is she going to travel to Spain?
examples.phonetic: /ɪz ʃiː ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈtrævəl tə speɪn/
examples.note: A questions, da 'to be' a fuskar kalmar, kamar yadda a Espanyol: 'Ta za ta tafi...?' (amma a Espanyol ba muka canza ba).

examples.original: They aren't going to stay at home.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈɑːrnt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə steɪ æt hoʊm/
examples.translation: Suna ba za su zama a gida ba.
examples.note: Zaka iya yin tsari mai yankin 'aren't' don 'are not'.

examples.original: Are you going to help me?
examples.note: Yi tunani da farashin da ke da turanci da Espanyol: a nan muna da 'are you' a fuskar kalmar, amma a Espanyol muna da 'Zan tafi...?' amma muna da 'Zan tafi...?' da yau.

levels.label: Predictions with Evidence
levels.translation: Fatansa masu nuni da aka gani

examples.original: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
examples.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə klaʊdz! ɪt ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə reɪn/
examples.translation: Duba gajimare! Za ya yi ruwa.
examples.note: Muna amfani da 'going to' don fatansa masu nuni da aka gani ko da aka lura.

examples.original: She is going to be late (she missed the bus).
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə biː leɪt (ʃiː mɪst ðə bʌs)/
examples.translation: Ta za ta zo da haske (ta rasa bas).
examples.note: An nuna cewa ta rasa bas, saboda haka muna amfani da 'going to'.

examples.original: The car is going to crash!
examples.note: A yankin matsalar da za a yi, muna amfani da 'going to'.
